description: This Java interface defines a repository for managing email label associations in a Spring Data JPA project. It includes methods for finding email labels by owner, email, and label, as well as retrieving paged email IDs.
external_methods: Optional<EmailLabel> findByOwnerAndEmailAndLabel(User owner, Email email, Label label)
@Query "select el.email.id from EmailLabel el where el.owner = :owner and el.label = :label order by el.createdAt desc"
Page<Long> findEmailIdsByOwnerAndLabel(@Param("owner") User owner, @Param("label") Label label, Pageable pageable)
calls: select el.email.id from EmailLabel el where el.owner = :owner and el.label = :label
